paragraphs.text: Cortex Harness — open protocol, schema, and reference tooling
English | 简体中文
# Cortex Harness
> **See it in 60 seconds:** Done is a check result, not a claim — a public demo of one loop tick (`t
ick -> propose -> check -> try-complete`) where two of five items are refused because the evidence d
oes not match. No model call, no server.

Cortex Harness is the open protocol and reference tooling for running CORTEX
work as small Blocks. A

Block has its own entrypoint, tests, and public
contract. The CORTEX Kernel remains the authority f

or leases, replay,
receipts, and completion decisions.

The public constitution is the CORTEX Six Laws, also called the CORTEX
Collaboration Constitution. E

nglish is the source language for the engine
and for these docs. Simplified Chinese counterparts are
README.zh-CN.md and docs/zh-CN/.

This repository holds the Apache-2.0 license, the export allowlist, the
`cortexharness.org` docs, an
d the directory reviewed Blocks land in.
## Quickstart

Install Node.js 24 or newer. Cloning and testing does not need a CORTEX
server or a DSH install.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`npm test` runs the Node.js test runner, the export grep gate, and the CJK gate.

To send live commands, run a CORTEX task-pool server on loopback and install
the adapter into a loca

l DSH Web profile. Keep the token in the host
environment:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then, in the chat input:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`CORTEX_API_BASE_URL` must use `127.0.0.1`, `localhost`, or `::1`. The default
is `http://127.0.0.1:

8787`. `manifest` is a relative path inside the manifest
root configured on that server. The adapter

can inspect, enqueue, and recover.
Settlement and completion stay on the CORTEX side.

The registry name `cortex-dsh-web-command` is reserved for a later npm
release. No registry release
is published from this repository yet.
## Architecture
### Blocks

`discovery-chain-index` is the first Block. It builds an index of a discovery
chain, the ordered rec

ord of what the harness found, so later blocks can read
that index.

That block is still under review and is not exported into this repository.
When the review finishes,

it lands in `blocks/` as
`blocks/discovery-chain-index`, with the entry script
`scripts/discovery-c

hain-index.mjs`. The candidate list, including the
`cortex-loop` self-improvement engine, is in ROAD

dex.mjs`. The candidate list, including the
`cortex-loop` self-improvement engine, is in ROADMAP.md.
### Reference adapter

`packages/dsh-web-cortex-command` is the
host-side DSH Web bridge that is already in the tree. The b

rowser sends a
`/cortex` slash command and receives a short summary. The host process calls
`/v1/nat

ive-task-pool/{status,enqueue,recover}` on the loopback API with
`CORTEX_API_TOKEN`. Error text has

the token replaced with `[redacted]`
before it returns.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The repository root `package.json` is the GitHub-installable bundle for that
plugin. Its `dsh.bundle

.patch` field points at
`packages/dsh-web-cortex-command/cordis.patch.yml`.

The adapter is not an allowlisted class in ALLOWLIST.md. It
remains as a pre-allowlist export.
## Website

The docs site is VitePress under `docs/`. English pages are the
source. `docs/zh-CN/` is the Simplif

ied Chinese display layer.
The nav language menu switches locales. The canonical host is
`cortexharn
ess.org`. `cortexharness.ai` is reserved and has no site.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The static output is `docs/.vitepress/dist`. Cloudflare Pages project
`cortexharness-org` is named i

n wrangler.toml. CI builds the
site on push to `main`. It does not deploy.
## Public boundary

Exports follow ALLOWLIST.md. Credentials, vaults, customer
records, store data, and local runtime st

ate stay out. The grep gate enforces
the hard bans. The CJK gate keeps Chinese, Japanese, and Korean

characters
inside the zh-CN docs and the fixture allowlist.
